# Procedure trigger index

<!-- GENERATED by Skills/tools/build_trigger_index.py from each procedure's
frontmatter. Never edit by hand: change the procedure and rerun. -->

When the user asks for something like a phrase below, open that procedure
and follow it. Phrases are examples; match the intent, not the wording.

| Procedure | What it is for | Trigger phrases |
|---|---|---|
| [feedback](feedback-SKILL.md) | Report a bug in the Fieldbook OS kit to its public repository, sanitized, with the user's yes before anything is sent. | "file a bug"; "report a bug"; "report a kit problem"; "send feedback on the kit" |
| [migrate](migrate-SKILL.md) | Audit the setup the user had before this workspace and, part by part and only on their yes, bring it into the workspace's formats. | "adopt my existing setup"; "migrate my notes"; "import my old memory"; "bring my old task list in" |
| [new-project](new-project-SKILL.md) | Set up a new project in the workspace with the user, including its rules, memory, inbox and its own dashboard tab designed with them. | "new project"; "start a project"; "add a project"; "set up a project" |
| [recall](recall-SKILL.md) | Search memory for past decisions, facts or history, when the user asks about the past or a session needs history the files it read at start do not hold. | "what did we decide about"; "when did we"; "do you remember"; "search memory" |
| [remember](remember-SKILL.md) | Store, update or delete a fact in working memory, or clean memory up, when the user asks for it. | "remember this"; "note that"; "forget about"; "clean up memory" |
| [tour](tour-SKILL.md) | A guided, hands-on tour of a Fieldbook OS workspace for a new user, ending with their first real project and work item. | "give me the tour"; "guided tour"; "show me around"; "how does this work" |
| [work-item](work-item-SKILL.md) | Create a work item for work that will not finish this session, or complete one; the system itself is described in Work Items/README.md. | "add a work item"; "new work item"; "spec this up"; "complete WI-NN"; "close out this work item" |
